results.summary: This design is an 8-voice synthesizer that generates eight independent audio voices from eight button inputs. Each button selects a voice output, with the frequency divisions described as vibe coded. The project is implemented in Wokwi and provides eight UI pins for buttons and eight output pins for voices. No external hardware is specified, and the documentation is limited to placeholder text, so the exact synthesis method and testing procedure are not detailed.

This design is a 6-7 flipper, likely a seven-segment display decoder or driver, with eight input pins and eight output pins labeled for segments. The inputs include in0 through in7, with in5 and in6 also labeled ON, and outputs correspond to segments such as top, right_top, etc. It is implemented in Wokwi and requires no external hardware according to the placeholder documentation. The documentation is minimal, so the exact functionality and testing method are not described.
